capabilities: Search and read notes in approved folders for ChatGPT
Preview and stage proposed note updates before applying them
Back up existing files and block overwrites with source hashes
Pair ChatGPT to the vault with a pairing code
Enforce folder-scoped access and scheduled automation policies
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not a tool for a specific 'second brain' vault method; it works on any user-approved folders.
extras: Manifest warns the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Desktop-only (loopback local bridge); Obsidian must be running and connected when ChatGPT accesses the vault. Public relay mode uses outbound encrypted connections hosted by Cloudflare. No OpenAI API key, ads, telemetry, or payment flow; deletion is intentionally unsupported.
problem: ChatGPT has no safe way to search, read, or edit notes in a local Obsidian vault without unrestricted file access or risk of overwriting newer edits.

relations.evidence: Second Brain Updater connects the @Obsidian ChatGPT plugin to user-approved folders

summary: Bridge that connects the ChatGPT @Obsidian plugin to approved vault folders for scoped reading, previewed updates, backups, and conflict checks.
